title: Final Creator/SAA Product Integration
objective: Complete the Creator half of normalized SMB-10 by integrating the completed SAA-01..30 family into finished Player/GM/Creator product UX as a first-class Creator workflow, preserving SMB10A product-shell authority and SAA canonical authoring contracts while keeping SMB-11 controlled sharing/interchange separate.
acceptance: Creator entry, project create/open/resume and ordinary authoring journeys are first-class product workflows rather than developer-facing surfaces.

The integration consumes SMB10A.1 core product UX and SAA-30.1 terminal capability evidence without creating a replacement app shell, comic document, page/panel/layer ledger, history ledger, asset/provenance ledger or narrative owner.
Authorization is evaluated before protected Creator/SAA project projection, with no client-side role grant or hidden owner-state leakage.
Responsive desktop/mobile layouts plus semantic text, keyboard and touch equivalents cover the blocking Creator journey.
Offline/provider-off, recovery-required, forbidden and service-unavailable states are explicit and preserve stable SAA project/version identity across resume/recovery.
SAA packaging/export/interchange capabilities remain governed SAA projections; controlled user-to-user sharing, marketplace/community and campaign-instantiation sharing remain SMB-11 authority.
Optional AI and paid cloud are not required for the blocking Creator/SAA workflow, and no provider call or external upload is required for acceptance.
Completion emits a capability-only SMB-11 readiness handoff without selecting or starting SMB-11.
boundaries: SMB10A.1 and SAA-01..30 remain sealed predecessor contracts.
SMB10B integrates finished product UX only; it does not become canonical Character, Campaign, Scene, Dialogue, ARI, AAI, SAA authoring, renderer, history, collaboration or publication authority.
No duplicate app shell, SAA project/page/panel/layer/history ledger, asset/provenance registry or owner-domain state is created.
No public marketplace, public community sharing, remote tester distribution, release/deployment, commerce or paid-provider activation is authorized.
SMB-11 remains blocked until verified SMB10B closeout.
next_action: Establish causal RED for first-class Creator/SAA product UX over sealed SMB10A.1 and SAA-30.1, then implement only SMB10B.

last_material_progress.evidence: Owner Continue reconciled DAG schema 1.0.5, verified SMB10A and SAA-30 start gates, and authorized cross-family GPR-slot reuse for SMB10B.
